description: US Department of Transportaion - National Bicycle Network is a data set deposited in ICPSR by its authors Shuqing Wang (US Department of Transportation). Last updated on 2024-Aug-22 The FHWA Office of Highway Policy Information (HPPI) has been attempting to compile a set of bicycle route geospatial data for the entire nation based on data and information released by public agencies such as state transportation departments, local Metropolitan Planning Organizations, local Councils of Government, cities, and county public works ... Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and ICPSR normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-icpsr-repository.
